# Certificates of information, instruction, and training

## Rules

- Every lab and workshop user completes the relevant Moodle test before first entry and receives a safety introduction from the GSR / BSO.
- Persons working with Group 2 organisms receive a biosafety instruction before starting the work and at least once per year afterwards.
- All users repeat the safety instruction at least once per year (annual refresher).
- Every introduction and every refresher includes the maternity protection information: *some chemicals and biological agents used in the lab and workshop are hazardous to pregnancy and breastfeeding; pregnant or breastfeeding persons inform the GSR confidentially, so that a risk assessment can be made.*
- Every instruction is confirmed on a training record sheet with the signatures of the participant and the instructor. The signed sheets are scanned and stored on Google Drive; the paper originals are kept in the GSR office (CLD D 2.1).

## Laboratory

Results of the Moodle test [*Safety in the laboratory*](https://moodle-app2.let.ethz.ch/enrol/index.php?id=4041) for all lab users are stored on Google Drive.

[Safety briefing confirmations](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1UHip_yCIzg_-2OyB7_scDbxoFQTYKjJ2/view?usp=sharing) are stored on Google Drive.

## Workshop

Results of the Moodle test [*Safety in the mechanical shop*](https://moodle-app2.let.ethz.ch/enrol/index.php?id=4042) for all workshop users are stored on Google Drive.

[Safety briefing confirmations](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1YK6C84gHawExi-1WTkUfwDvzZfVt94Wr?usp=drive_link) are stored on Google Drive.
